sources.title: JARVIS — Autonomous AI Assistant
sources.snippet: JARVIS keeps routine intelligence close to the metal. Qwen 2.5, Qwythos-9B, and Gemma run locally through Ollama on Apple Silicon—private, responsive, and available without a round trip to the cloud. When a mission demands deeper context or heavier reasoning, the same orchestration layer routes work to Google Cloud Vertex AI, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or your own provider.

sources.title: Jarvis - Agentic AI Assistant
sources.snippet: Jarvis is an agentic AI assistant able to handle real-world tasks autonomously without human intervention, even using multiple different tools.
